atAGlance: Xôi bắp is sticky rice with corn, usually with mung bean, fried shallot, sugar or savory toppings.
whatItIs: Xôi bắp is sticky rice with corn, mung bean, fried shallots, and sometimes sugar or coconut depending on the stall. It can lean savory, sweet, or both.
howToEnjoy: Taste before adding sugar or chili because stalls vary. The best bites have chewy corn, soft mung bean, and fragrant fried shallots together.
howLocalsOrder: Order xôi bắp when you want a lighter, corn-sweet sticky rice. Ask for less sugar, extra fried shallots, or pack to go before the packet is closed.
worthKnowing: Bắp means corn in southern Vietnamese usage; this is a useful word for reading snacks and dessert menus.
goodToKnow: Xôi bắp can lean lightly sweet or lightly savory depending on the seller. Look for chewy corn, sticky rice, mung bean, fried shallots, and a sesame-sugar or coconut finish.
